final: WITH c AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(*) AS n FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, n AS record_count, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(n) FROM c) AS ratio_to_average FROM c ORDER BY scope
